customer: Hello, I'm hoping to sell my minivan to Northwind Auto as part of upgrading to something bigger. It's completely paid off, but I can't find the paper title anywhere. I live in Corlan. Is there still a way to move forward with the sale? Thank you for your help!
agent: Thank you for reaching out, and congratulations on the upgrade! Because your minivan is fully paid off, we'll need a duplicate title from the state of Corlan before we can complete the purchase. We can't buy a paid-off car without a title. The good news is you can still get an offer and book an appointment while you wait for the duplicate, and how long it takes depends on your state.
